title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Signal Print. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Signal Print
options.thesis: The pack paints itself: every product is shown by its own audio, rendered as true spectral color.
options.viewport: A full-bleed analyzer hero: the featured pack's demo renders as a live spectrogram behind the store's claim; play and scrub is the primary action.
options.risk: Collapses into the category's neon-dark default the moment glow creeps in. Matte discipline is the whole bet.

raised.raise: Pack contents are documented on the signal itself: leader-line callouts annotate the waveform with what the pack contains.
One warm source per viewport: a single diffused amber light (the armed state) humanizes the graphite — light diffuses, never edges.
One geometry drives everything: the demo audio drives the hero's art, layout rhythm, and motion state together, not just the picture.

options.label: The Rack
options.thesis: The store is ACE's own outboard rack: every pack is a unit with a faceplate, meters, and a patch point.
options.viewport: The rack fills the viewport as vertical outboard units; each pack is a faceplate with meters and a patch-in action.
options.risk: Rack skeuomorphism is a known love of this category — familiarity is the honest trade.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope on a signal bench
options.thesis: The store is a measurement bench: every pack is a signal you trigger, scale, and lock.
options.viewport: One bench screen: the featured pack's trace rides the graticule while knobs and a trigger arm the audition.
options.case: Fuses cleanly — auditioning becomes triggering, deeply native to producers; loses on clarity, since one trace can't show a pack's full spectral content the way true spectrogram color can.
options.risk: Phosphor-on-black sits one step from the category's neon-glow default.

options.label: Multiplane Morning
options.thesis: The catalog is a painted depth stack: you browse by moving the camera through layers.
options.viewport: Five painted planes deep; the featured transition pack plays as the camera sinks through the scene.
options.case: Holds the video-editor half of the audience — layer depth is their craft — but the painterly mood risks reading as an animation studio rather than an asset store.
options.risk: Mood can outrun merchandise; the packs must stay the art.

options.label: Data Sublime
options.thesis: The catalog as pure data: barcode fields and monospace density where the pack is information.
options.viewport: A black-and-white data wall; the newest pack is a barcode column the cursor samples.
options.case: The electronic audience identifies instantly; clarity loses — you cannot see what you buy, and auditioning becomes abstraction.
options.risk: Strobe and pure black/white demand strict accessibility guardrails.

options.label: Akari Workshop
options.case: Fuses poorly: lantern warmth has no native tie to production tools, so the audience doesn't identify.
options.kept: One warm light source per viewport, diffused, never edged.

options.label: Dress-Code Document
options.case: Fuses poorly: the garment carrier is off-world for creators, though its annotation grammar fit pack contents well.
options.kept: Leader-line annotations that document the pack directly on its signal.

options.label: Guide Map
options.case: Fuses poorly: theme-park playfulness undercuts the pro-tool positioning.
options.kept: One geometry drives layout, art, and state together.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark creator storefront this category ships — covers, play buttons, clean grid — executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Dark hero with the value line, then the pack grid exactly where visitors expect it.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Reason or Splice by design.
